prs.title: fix(streamable-http): wait for post_writer before yielding
prs.author: Epochex
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Race condition in the StreamableHTTP client transport: post_writer is started via the task group without any readiness signal, so a caller can proceed (yield the session / send the first message) before post_writer has entered its stream context and is actually listening on write_stream_reader, causing messages sent in that window to be lost or hang. Both PRs fix it the same way: adding an anyio TaskStatus parameter to post_writer and calling task_status.started(None) once its context managers are entered, so tg.start() blocks until it is truly ready. (2 PRs)

members.title: Race condition in streamable http
members.author: AydarAkhmetzyanov
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Race condition in the StreamableHTTP client transport: post_writer is started via the task group without any readiness signal, so a caller can proceed (yield the session / send the first message) before post_writer has entered its stream context and is actually listening on write_stream_reader, causing messages sent in that window to be lost or hang. Both PRs fix it the same way: adding an anyio TaskStatus parameter to post_writer and calling task_status.started(None) once its context managers are entered, so tg.start() blocks until it is truly ready.
